dedupe_keys.name: flanders transmitting antennas map conformity certificates and yearly 5g technology on antenna sites departement omgeving

description: The Flemish Department of Environment publishes the fixed transmitting antennas that need a certificate of conformity under the environmental regulations (Vlarem II, article 6.10.2.2), which cover mobile network, broadcast and other radio antennas. The transmitting antennas map has been available since January 2014 and, since February 2019, shows the centre of each certificate file as a point, updated daily with newly approved certificates. Each point links to the issued certificate as a PDF. The layer is offered as GeoPackage in the Belgian Lambert 72 and Lambert 2008 systems and as WMS and WFS services. A companion series, 5G technology on sites with transmitting antennas, gives one map a year from 2019 to 2024. It covers every Flemish site where a certificate has been applied for, and so where mobile antennas may be present, and marks whether the site already carries 5G. A comparable register of antennas holding an environmental permit or declaration exists for the Brussels-Capital Region (Bruxelles Environnement, 2010 to 2024, CC BY 4.0). Coverage: Flanders, Belgium. Format and access: GeoPackage download and OGC services through the Flemish metadata catalogue, free under the Flemish model licence for free reuse. Caveats: points are certificate file centroids, not exact antenna positions, and carry no operator technical parameters beyond what the certificates state; sites outside the certificate regime are missing. Simulation uses: locations of mobile and broadcast sites for hazard exposure, and yearly 5G roll-out at site level. Related records: the BIPT data portal gives coverage by municipality; the Dutch Antenneregister and the Finnsenderen Norway mobile transmitters give comparable site registers.
